artboards.title: Women’s Muay Thai & Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Classes in Nashv

annotations.text:
13 PROGRAM PAGES — every word is the client's own, verbatim from their live site.

CLASS TIMES ARE SHARED. No page has a schedule typed into it; all of them read data/classes.json. Verified by renaming a class in that file and watching it change on both the boxing page and the master schedule. Adult pages exclude kids classes; kids pages carry their own.

THIS ROUND:
· Sports Performance rebuilt as the athlete page — leads with Train Like An Athlete, then the client's own 'Train Just Like The PROS' block. Coach block added for Tim Sumich; his background is a GOLD PLACEHOLDER because he is not on the current site, so there is nothing on file to quote. Note their live copy credits Co-Owner UFC Lightweight Contender Michael Chandler as the program's inspiration.
· Exercise Classes & Open Gym became OPEN GYM — the old page sold a variety of fitness classes that no longer exists. Rebuilt from the client's own Facilities copy: 40,000 sqft, 13,000 sqft of mats, cage and ring, Recovery Room. No class times, by design.
· Kids BJJ body photo swapped — it was a near-duplicate of its hero.

Still coming: coaches, FAQ, then Events (GoHighLevel embed) and Sponsors as two pages.

MASTER SCHEDULE — all 86 classes, times aligned across the week. Filter chips work: Adults (69), Kids (12), Fitness (5).

This grid and every program page read the same file, so a class edited once moves everywhere.
